title: R. W. Gallaher — drugstore advertisement
text:
R. W. GALLAHER.

In the line of Drugs Savoy is very fortunate in having the best. R. W. Gallaher is a registered pharmacist and has been in business a number of years, in fact, prepared himself immediately after leaving college. He has a nice trade that has confidence in him and feel that none but the purest drugs will be used in compounding their prescriptions. His store is always neat and clean and a pleasant greeting awaits every customer. He also carries a nice line of furniture and has built up a good trade with that.
notes: Early-era advertisement or business profile. Left margin slightly clipped; a few words at start of lines partially cut.
